name: guitar_project
description: Interactive guitar and bass fretboard visualizer with scales, chords, the CAGED system, a metronome, chord-progression and tab playback, and a looper. Ships as a PWA and a Capacitor Android app.

scripts.sync:www: cp index.html sw.js manifest.json www/ && mkdir -p www/icons && cp icons/* www/icons/
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:www && cap sync android
